notes: All yields are energy fractions relative to the total input energy. w = Omega T0 (positive = blue). eta_DW uses the hard gate |tau| >= 8 as defined in the task; eta_DW_smoothgate (tanh gate, width 1) is a diagnostic only.

item4_raman_model.h_R: (tau1^2+tau2^2)/(tau1 tau2^2) exp(-t/tau2) sin(t/tau1), t >= 0 (single damped oscillator, Blow-Wood form); int h_R dt = 1
item4_raman_model.nonlinearity: (1-f_R)|A|^2 A + f_R A (h_R * |A|^2), circular FFT convolution, kernel sampled at the grid step
item4_raman_model.self_steepening: suppressed with omega0 T0 = 1e6; the Raman time constants are physical (independent of omega0 in this solver)

grid_robust_variants_from_saved_spectra.definition: eta_*_fracedge: band sum with the bin straddling w_z weighted by its fraction above w_z (bins of width dw centred on w_k); smoothed_peak: band maximum of |A_k|^2 after a boxcar of width ~1 in w (fringe-averaged NSR level; smoothed_local_peak = largest interior local maximum of the smoothed band spectrum, i.e. the DW hump). Computed on the base-step runs.
